decisions.choice: Psalm 118: a song of thanks for the festival procession
decisions.reason: The last psalm of the Hallel (113-118) is a liturgy: a call to give thanks (verses 1-4), the king's or worshiper's story of rescue (5-18), the entry through the temple gates (19-21), the people's and priests' response (22-27), and a closing thanks (28-29). Several voices seem to speak in turn.

decisions.choice: the refrain of thanksgiving
decisions.reason: "Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his loyal love is forever" was the song of the temple singers (1 Chronicles 16:34; Ezra 3:11) and opens Psalms 106, 107 and 136. Verse 29 repeats it to close the psalm.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: for his loyal love lasts forever (B); His faithful love lasts forever (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain (ki le'olam chasdo) has the same English each time it occurs at each level, here and in verses 2-4 and 29, as in Psalm 136.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: the refrain worded as in Psalms 106:1 and 107:1, here and in verses 2-4 and 29
alternatives: "lòng nhân từ của Ngài còn đến đời đời"
decisions.reason: The terms note gives one wording of the refrain at each level for all the psalms that use it. |

decisions.choice: The refrain in its one Korean form (as 106:1, 107:1), and the voices of the liturgy by speech level: plain commands to the people (1-4, 19, 29), the singer's story in the plain style with "나" (5-18), 합쇼체 to God (21, 25, 28), "너희" in the priests' blessing (26)
decisions.reason: The psalm is a liturgy with several voices (meaning decision); the Hebrew marks who is spoken to by "you" and "he", and Korean must mark it by speech level (style guide section 7a). In verse 25 the people pray together with "저희".

decisions.choice: the refrain in the words of 1 Chronicles 16:34 and Psalm 107:1, here and in verse 29
alternatives: O seu amor leal dura para sempre (R)
decisions.reason: The temple's refrain of thanks (m2) keeps one wording at each level wherever it is sung in full, as 1 Chronicles 16:34 set it, so Readable keeps "amor leal" in it. The people's answer in verses 2-4 says "amor fiel" at Readable, as the book does elsewhere (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 118
decisions.reason: Amharic has no deity_pronoun spans: the Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change. God is spoken of with the ordinary pronouns (እርሱ, አንተ) at every level.

decisions.choice: The refrain as Ezra 3:11, 1 Chronicles 16:34 and 107:1 (also verse 29; verses 2-4 quote its second half)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of verses 1 and 29 is the same as 107:1, so the Amharic is the same.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God is spoken of with the honorific third person and addressed with the devotional तू (verses 21, 25, 28).

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Chronicles 16:34
decisions.reason: The refrain is the temple song of 1 Chronicles 16:34 (as Psalm 107:1); Hindi keeps that verse's wording at each level, without its line break, here and in verse 29, and its second half in verses 2-4.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:34
decisions.reason: The refrain is the line of 1 Chronicles 16:34, so each level copies that verse's Russian (without its line break, as the English here is one line), as Psalm 107:1 does; verses 2-4 repeat its second half and verse 29 the whole.

decisions.choice: The thanksgiving refrain word for word as 1 Chronicles 16:34 and Psalm 106:1 (誠実 L, 変わらぬいつくしみ B, R), here and in 118:29
decisions.reason: The Psalter repeats this refrain (106, 107, 118, 136); one wording keeps it recognizable (PSA-1)

decisions.choice: The refrain is "бо його незмінна любов — навіки" (L), "його незмінна любов триває навіки" (B), "його вірна любов триває вічно" (R), the same wording each time it comes in Psalms 118 and 136
decisions.reason: One fixed wording per level lets the refrain sound as a sung response, as the Hebrew repeats the same words; it keeps the book's word for hesed.

hi.L: हारून का घराना अब कहे: \q "क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।"
hi.B: हारून का घराना अब यह कहे: \q "उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।"
hi.R: हारून के परिवार के याजक कहें, \q "उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है!"

ru.L: Пусть скажет ныне дом Аарона: \q «Потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.»
ru.B: Пусть скажет это ныне дом Аарона: \q «Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.»
ru.R: Пусть священники из рода Аарона скажут: \q «Его неизменная любовь длится вечно!»

ja.L: アロンの家は、さあ、言え。 \q 「その誠実はとこしえに[続く]。」
ja.B: さあ、アロンの家は言え。 \q 「その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。」
ja.R: アロンの家の祭司たちは、さあ、言おう。 \q 「その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。」

uk.L: Нехай же скаже дім Аарона: \q «Бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.»
uk.B: Нехай дім Аарона скаже це тепер: \q «Його незмінна любов триває навіки.»
uk.R: Нехай священники з родини Аарона скажуть: \q «Його вірна любов триває вічно!»

records.literal_gloss: Let [those who] fear YHWH say now: For forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: Let those who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} say now: "For {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever."
en.B: Let those who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} say it now: "His loyal love lasts forever."
en.R: Let all who fear and honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} say, "His faithful love lasts forever!"

fr.L: Que ceux qui craignent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} disent donc : « Car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours. »
fr.B: Que ceux qui craignent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le disent maintenant : « Son amour fidèle dure toujours. »
fr.R: Que tous ceux qui honorent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect disent : « Son amour fidèle dure toujours ! »

sw.L: Wale wamchao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na waseme sasa: "Kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele."
sw.B: Wale wanaomcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na waseme sasa: "Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele."
sw.R: Wote wanaomcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumheshimu na waseme, "Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele!"

es.L: Digan ahora los que temen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre».
es.B: Que lo digan ahora los que temen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Su amor fiel dura para siempre».
es.R: Que digan todos los que temen y honran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¡Su amor fiel dura para siempre!».

vi.L: Nguyện những người kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nói bây giờ: "Vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời."
vi.B: Hỡi những người kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, bây giờ hãy nói: "Tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời."
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả những ai kính sợ và tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy nói: "Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời!"

ko.L: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하는 이들이 말하게 하여라. "참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다."
ko.B: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하는 이들이 말하게 하여라. "그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려운 마음으로 섬기는 사람들이 모두 말하게 하여라. "그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다!"

pt.L: Que os que temem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} digam agora: "Porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre."
pt.B: Que os que temem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} digam agora: "O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre."
pt.R: Que todos os que temem e honram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} digam: "O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre!"

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈሩ አሁን እንዲህ ይበሉ፦ «ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።»
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈሩ አሁን እንዲህ ይበሉ፦ «ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈሩና የሚያከብሩ ሁሉ፦ «ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ይኖራል!» ይበሉ።

hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय माननेवाले अब यह कहें: \q "उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर और भय माननेवाले सब लोग कहें, \q "उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है!"

ru.L: Пусть скажут ныне боящиеся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: \q «Потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.»
ru.B: Пусть скажут это ныне боящиеся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: \q «Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.»
ru.R: Пусть все, кто боится и чтит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, скажут: \q «Его неизменная любовь длится вечно!»

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を恐れる者たちは、さあ、言え。 \q 「その誠実はとこしえに[続く]。」
ja.B: さあ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を畏れる者たちは言え。 \q 「その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をおそれ敬う人たちはみな、さあ、言おう。 \q 「その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。」

uk.L: Нехай же скажуть ті, хто боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}: \q «Бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.»
uk.B: Нехай ті, хто боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, скажуть це тепер: \q «Його незмінна любов триває навіки.»
uk.R: Нехай усі, хто боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і шанує {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, скажуть: \q «Його вірна любов триває вічно!»

records.literal_gloss: From the distress I called Yah; Yah answered me in the broad place.

en.L: Out of the narrow place I called [to] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} answered me in the broad place.
en.B: When I was hemmed in I called to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} answered me by bringing me out into open space.
en.R: I was in great trouble, and I called to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} answered and brought me out to a safe, open place.

fr.L: De l’étroitesse j’ai appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} m’a répondu au large.
fr.B: Quand j’étais à l’étroit, j’ai appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} m’a répondu en me faisant sortir au large.
fr.R: J’étais dans une grande détresse, et j’ai appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} m’a répondu et m’a fait sortir dans un lieu sûr et spacieux.

sw.L: Kutoka mahali pembamba nilimwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} akanijibu mahali pana.
sw.B: Nilipobanwa nilimwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} akanijibu kwa kunitoa mahali penye nafasi.
sw.R: Nilikuwa katika taabu kubwa, nikamwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} alinijibu, akanitoa mpaka mahali salama na pana.

es.L: Desde la estrechez invoqué {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}; {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} me respondió en lugar espacioso.
es.B: Cuando estaba acorralado clamé {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}; {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} me respondió sacándome a un lugar abierto.
es.R: Estaba en grandes problemas, y clamé {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} me respondió y me sacó a un lugar abierto y seguro.

vi.L: Từ nơi chật hẹp tôi đã kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã đáp lời tôi nơi rộng rãi.
vi.B: Khi bị dồn vào thế bí, tôi kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đáp lời tôi bằng cách đưa tôi ra nơi thoáng rộng.
vi.R: Tôi gặp cảnh rất khốn khó, và tôi kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã đáp lời và đưa tôi ra một nơi rộng rãi, an toàn.

ko.L: 내가 좁은 곳에서 {{divine_name:주|야}}를 불렀더니, {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 넓은 곳에서 내게 응답하셨다.
ko.B: 내가 궁지에 몰렸을 때 {{divine_name:주|야}}께 부르짖었더니, {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 응답하셔서 나를 넓은 곳으로 이끌어 내셨다.
ko.R: 나는 큰 어려움에 빠져 {{divine_name:주|야}}께 부르짖었다. {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 응답하시고 나를 안전하고 넓은 곳으로 데려가 주셨다.

pt.L: Da angústia clamei {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Iá}}; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}} me respondeu no lugar espaçoso.
pt.B: Quando eu estava encurralado, clamei {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Iá}}; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}} me respondeu, levando-me para um lugar amplo.
pt.R: Eu estava em grande aflição e clamei {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Iá}}. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Iá}} me respondeu e me levou para um lugar seguro e espaçoso.

am.L: በጭንቅ ውስጥ ሆኜ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ጠራሁ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} በሰፊ ስፍራ መለሰልኝ።
am.B: በተከበብኩ ጊዜ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ጮኽኩ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} መልሶ ወደ ሰፊ ስፍራ አወጣኝ።
am.R: በታላቅ ችግር ውስጥ ነበርኩ፤ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ጮኽኩ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} መለሰልኝ፤ ወደ ሰፊና ሰላማዊ ስፍራም አወጣኝ።

hi.L: सकरे स्थान में से मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} [को] पुकारा; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने मुझे खुले स्थान में उत्तर दिया।
hi.B: जब मैं चारों ओर से घिरा था, तब मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} को पुकारा; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} मुझे उत्तर देकर खुले स्थान में निकाल लाए।
hi.R: मैं बड़े संकट में था, और मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} को पुकारा। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने उत्तर दिया, और वे मुझे एक सुरक्षित, खुले स्थान में ले आए।

ru.L: Из тесноты я воззвал [к] {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ях}}; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}} ответил мне на просторе.
ru.B: Когда меня стеснили, я воззвал к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ях}}; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}} ответил мне и вывел меня на простор.
ru.R: Я был в большой беде и воззвал к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ях}}. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}} ответил и вывел меня в безопасное, просторное место.

ja.L: 苦しみの狭い所から、わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を呼んだ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}は広い所で、わたしに答えてくださった。
ja.B: 追い詰められたとき、わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を呼んだ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}は答えて、わたしを広い所に出してくださった。
ja.R: わたしはひどく苦しんで、{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を呼んだ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}は答えて、わたしを安全な広い所に連れ出してくださった。

uk.L: З тісноти я кликав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}} відповів мені на просторі.
uk.B: Коли я був затиснутий звідусіль, я кликав до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}} відповів мені, вивівши мене на простір.
uk.R: Я був у великій біді й кликав до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}} відповів і вивів мене на безпечне, широке місце.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in 68:5 and Exodus 15:2). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: the narrow place ... the broad place: distress and freedom
decisions.reason: Distress (metsar) is being squeezed in a tight place; rescue is room to move (merchav), as in 4:2 and 18:20.

decisions.choice: answered me in the broad place: answered and set me free
decisions.reason: The phrase is short: the LORD answered by bringing him out into the open.

decisions.choice: bringing me out into (B); set me in (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the movement the Hebrew implies (m3).

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}}
decisions.reason: Yah is the short form of God's name. Like the full name, it is "el SEÑOR" by default, with "Yah" as the alternative the name setting gives.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA" with "Gia" as the divine_name alternative for the short name Yah, through the psalm
decisions.reason: The terms note gives Yah the same default as the full name; a reader who chooses the name sees "Gia" (verses 5, 14, 17-19). |

decisions.choice: Yah as "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}}", with "ያህ" as the alternative (verses 5, 14, 17-19)
decisions.reason: The short form of the name takes the divine_name span, as in Exodus 15:2 and Psalm 115:17.

decisions.choice: ГОСПОДЬ (Ях as the alternative)
decisions.reason: The short name Yah is the divine_name span with "Ях" as the alternative, inflected inside each option, as in Exodus 15:2.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH [is] for me; not I will fear; what can do to me a human?

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] for me; I will not fear; what can a human do to me?
en.B: With {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for me, I have no fear. What can any human being do to me?
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is on my side, so I am not afraid. What can anyone do to me?

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] pour moi ; je ne craindrai pas ; que peut me faire {{gender:un être humain|un homme}} ?
fr.B: Avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour moi, je n’ai pas peur. Que peut me faire {{gender:un être humain|un homme}} ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est de mon côté, alors je n’ai pas peur. Que peut-on me faire ?

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] kwa ajili yangu; sitaogopa; mwanadamu aweza kunifanyia nini?
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akiwa pamoja nami, sina hofu. Binadamu yeyote anaweza kunifanyia nini?
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu pamoja nami, kwa hiyo siogopi. Mtu yeyote anaweza kunidhuru vipi?

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [está] por mí; no temeré; ¿qué me puede hacer un ser humano?
es.B: Con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de mi parte, no tengo miedo. ¿Qué me puede hacer cualquier ser humano?
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está de mi lado, así que no tengo miedo. ¿Qué me puede hacer nadie?

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] với tôi; tôi sẽ không sợ hãi; loài người có thể làm gì tôi?
vi.B: Có {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở bên tôi, tôi chẳng sợ gì. Con người có thể làm gì được tôi?
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở về phía tôi, nên tôi không sợ. Ai có thể làm gì tôi được?

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 내 편이시니, 나는 두려워하지 않겠다. 사람이 나에게 무엇을 할 수 있겠느냐?
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 편이시니 나는 두렵지 않다. 사람이 나에게 무엇을 할 수 있겠느냐?
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 편이시니 나는 무섭지 않다. 누가 나에게 무엇을 할 수 있겠느냐?

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} [é] por mim; não temerei; que me fará um ser humano?
pt.B: Com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} a meu favor, não tenho medo. Que pode me fazer qualquer ser humano?
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} está do meu lado, por isso não vou ter medo. O que as pessoas podem fazer contra mim?

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእኔ [ነው]፤ አልፈራም፤ ሰው ምን ሊያደርገኝ ይችላል?
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከጎኔ ስላለ ምንም አልፈራም፤ ማንም ሰው ምን ሊያደርገኝ ይችላል?
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከጎኔ ነው፤ ስለዚህ አልፈራም። ሰዎች ምን ሊያደርጉኝ ይችላሉ?

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरी ओर [हैं]; मैं न डरूँगा; \q मनुष्य मेरा क्या करेगा?
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरी ओर हैं, तो मैं नहीं डरूँगा। \q कोई भी मनुष्य मेरा क्या कर सकता है?
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरी ओर हैं, इसलिए मैं नहीं डरूँगा। \q लोग मेरा क्या कर सकते हैं?

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} за меня; я не убоюсь; \q что сделает мне человек?
ru.B: Когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} за меня, я не буду бояться. \q Что может сделать мне человек?
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} на моей стороне, поэтому я не буду бояться. \q Что могут сделать мне люди?

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしの味方。わたしは恐れない。 \q 人がわたしに何ができるだろうか？
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしの味方なのだから、わたしは恐れない。 \q 人がわたしに何ができるだろうか？
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしの味方だから、わたしはこわくない。 \q だれがわたしに何をすることができるだろうか？

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — за мене; я не боятимуся; \q що може зробити мені людина?
uk.B: Коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} за мене, я не маю страху. \q Що може заподіяти мені будь-яка людина?
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} на моєму боці, тому я не боюся. \q Що хтось може мені зробити?

decisions.choice: quoted in Hebrews 13:6
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes this verse, from the ancient Greek translation, as the confident answer of those whom God will never leave. 56:5 and 56:12 say the same.

decisions.choice: for me: on my side
decisions.reason: "The LORD is for me" means he takes my part (56:10).

decisions.choice: não temerei; que me fará um ser humano? (L); Que pode me fazer qualquer ser humano? (B); O que as pessoas podem fazer contra mim? (R)
alternatives: o que o homem me pode fazer
decisions.reason: Hebrews 13:6 quotes this verse (m1), so the Portuguese keeps the words of its Portuguese at each level where the Hebrew is the same; Hebrews' "o meu ajudador" comes from the Greek and is not added here. The English has no gender setting, so "um ser humano" stands without one.

decisions.choice: "አልፈራም፤ ሰው ምን ሊያደርገኝ ይችላል?" as Hebrews 13:6; the first line follows the Hebrew: "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእኔ [ነው]"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 13:6 quotes the Greek translation, "The Lord is my helper"; the Hebrew says "the LORD is for me" (helper comes in verse 7). The Amharic keeps the New Testament's words for the shared lines and follows the Hebrew for the first.

decisions.choice: wording of Hebrews 13:6
decisions.reason: Hebrews 13:6 quotes this verse; Hindi keeps its wording for "I will not fear; what can man do to me?" at each level (मैं न डरूँगा; मनुष्य मेरा क्या करेगा? at Literal). Where Hebrews follows the Greek Old Testament with "the Lord is my helper", the Hebrew here says "the LORD is for me", so the first clause follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the words of Hebrews 13:6 after the first clause
decisions.reason: Hebrews 13:6 quotes the Greek Old Testament, "the Lord is my helper"; the Hebrew says "the LORD is for me", so the first clause translates the Hebrew, and the rest keeps the Russian of Hebrews 13:6 at each level, where the Hebrew says the same.

decisions.choice: Second half as Hebrews 13:6 (わたしは恐れない。人がわたしに何ができるだろうか？); but YHWH li "DNはわたしの味方" (Hebrew), not Hebrews' "主はわたしの助け手"
decisions.reason: m1: quoted in Hebrews 13:6, whose first clause follows the Greek; the psalm is translated from the Hebrew (m2: on my side)

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH [is] for me among my helpers, and I, I will look on those who hate me.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] for me among my helpers, and I will look on those who hate me.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is with me as my helper, and I will see the downfall of those who hate me.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is on my side to help me. I will see my enemies defeated.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] pour moi parmi ceux qui m’aident, et moi, je regarderai ceux qui me haïssent.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est avec moi pour m’aider, et je verrai la chute de ceux qui me haïssent.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est de mon côté pour m’aider. Je verrai mes ennemis vaincus.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] kwa ajili yangu kati ya wasaidizi wangu, nami nitawatazama wanaonichukia.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu pamoja nami kama msaidizi wangu, nami nitaona kuanguka kwa wale wanaonichukia.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko upande wangu kunisaidia. Nitawaona adui zangu wameshindwa.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [está] por mí entre los que me ayudan, y yo miraré a los que me odian.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está conmigo como mi ayudador, y veré la caída de los que me odian.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está de mi lado para ayudarme. Veré derrotados a mis enemigos.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] với tôi giữa những người giúp đỡ tôi, và tôi sẽ nhìn xem những kẻ ghét tôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng tôi, là Đấng giúp đỡ tôi, và tôi sẽ thấy kết cuộc của những kẻ ghét tôi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở về phía tôi để giúp tôi. Tôi sẽ thấy kẻ thù mình bị đánh bại.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나를 돕는 이들 가운데서 내 편이시니, 나는 나를 미워하는 자들을 [내려다]볼 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 도우시는 분으로 나와 함께 계시니, 나는 나를 미워하는 자들이 무너지는 것을 볼 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 편이 되어 나를 도우신다. 나는 내 원수들이 패하는 것을 볼 것이다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} [é] por mim entre os que me ajudam, e eu verei [a derrota dos] que me odeiam.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} está comigo como o meu ajudador, e eu verei a queda dos que me odeiam.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} está do meu lado para me ajudar. Vou ver os meus inimigos derrotados.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሚረዱኝ ጋር ለእኔ [ነው]፤ እኔም የሚጠሉኝን አያለሁ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ረዳቴ ሆኖ ከእኔ ጋር ነው፤ የሚጠሉኝም ሲወድቁ አያለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሊረዳኝ ከጎኔ ነው። ጠላቶቼ ድል ሆነው አያለሁ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे सहायकों में मेरी ओर [हैं], \q और मैं अपने बैरियों को देख लूँगा।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे सहायक बनकर मेरे साथ हैं, \q और मैं अपने बैरियों का पतन देखूँगा।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरी सहायता करने के लिए मेरी ओर हैं। \q मैं अपने शत्रुओं को हारा हुआ देखूँगा।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} за меня среди моих помощников, \q и я посмотрю на ненавидящих меня.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} со мной как мой помощник, \q и я увижу падение тех, кто меня ненавидит.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} на моей стороне и помогает мне. \q Я увижу своих врагов побеждёнными.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしを助ける者たちのうちにあって、わたしの味方[である]。 \q わたしは、わたしを憎む者たちを[勝ち誇って]見る。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしと共にいて、助けてくださる。 \q わたしは、わたしを憎む者たちが倒れるのを見る。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は味方になって、わたしを助けてくださる。 \q わたしは、敵が負けるのを見るだろう。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — за мене серед моїх помічників, \q і я подивлюся на тих, хто мене ненавидить.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зі мною як мій помічник, \q і я побачу падіння тих, хто мене ненавидить.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} на моєму боці, щоб допомагати мені. \q Я побачу моїх ворогів переможеними.

decisions.choice: among my helpers: as my helper
alternatives: is among those who help me
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean that the LORD is one of his helpers, but more likely it means that he is the helper, the one who counts (54:6).

decisions.choice: look on those who hate me: see their defeat
decisions.reason: As in 112:8.

decisions.choice: see my enemies defeated
alternatives: look on those who hate me
decisions.reason: As in 112:8.

source.text: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Better to take refuge in YHWH than to trust in humankind.

en.L: [It is] better to take refuge in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} than to trust in humankind.
en.B: It is better to make {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your refuge than to rely on human beings.
en.R: It is better to run to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for safety than to depend on people.

fr.L: [Il est] meilleur de se réfugier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} que de se confier en {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}.
fr.B: Il vaut mieux faire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son refuge que de compter sur les {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.R: Il vaut mieux courir vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour être en sécurité que de compter sur les gens.

sw.L: [Ni] bora kukimbilia kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuliko kumwamini mwanadamu.
sw.B: Ni afadhali kumfanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa kimbilio lako kuliko kuwategemea wanadamu.
sw.R: Ni bora kukimbilia kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} upate usalama kuliko kuwategemea watu.

es.L: Mejor [es] refugiarse en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que confiar en el ser humano.
es.B: Es mejor hacer {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu refugio que apoyarte en los seres humanos.
es.R: Es mejor correr {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} para estar a salvo que depender de la gente.

vi.L: [Thà] nương náu nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} còn tốt hơn là tin cậy loài người.
vi.B: Thà lấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm nơi ẩn náu còn hơn nương cậy loài người.
vi.R: Chạy đến với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để được an toàn thì tốt hơn là trông cậy vào con người.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 피하는 것이 사람을 신뢰하는 것보다 낫다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 피난처로 삼는 것이 사람을 의지하는 것보다 낫다.
ko.R: 사람을 의지하는 것보다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 달려가 피하는 것이 더 낫다.

pt.L: [É] melhor refugiar-se {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}} do que confiar no ser humano.
pt.B: É melhor fazer {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} o seu refúgio do que depender de seres humanos.
pt.R: É melhor correr para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} em busca de proteção do que depender das pessoas.

am.L: በሰው ከመታመን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} መጠለል ይሻላል።
am.B: በሰው ልጆች ከመመካት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መጠጊያ ማድረግ ይሻላል።
am.R: በሰዎች ከመደገፍ ለደኅንነት ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መሮጥ ይሻላል።

hi.L: मनुष्य पर भरोसा रखने से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शरण लेना उत्तम [है]।
hi.B: मनुष्यों पर निर्भर रहने से अच्छा है \q कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को अपना शरणस्थान बनाओ।
hi.R: लोगों पर निर्भर रहने से अच्छा है \q कि सुरक्षा के लिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पास दौड़ो।

ru.L: Лучше искать убежища в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕ|Яхве}}, \q чем надеяться на человека.
ru.B: Лучше сделать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} своим прибежищем, \q чем полагаться на людей.
ru.R: Лучше бежать к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} за защитой, \q чем зависеть от людей.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に身を避けることは、 \q 人に信頼することよりも良い。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を避け所とすることは、 \q 人間に信頼することよりも良い。
ja.R: 人に信頼するよりも、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のもとに逃げ込むほうが良い。

uk.L: Краще шукати притулку в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДІ|Ягве}}, \q ніж покладатися на людину.
uk.B: Краще зробити {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} своїм притулком, \q ніж покладатися на людей.
uk.R: Краще бігти по захист до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q ніж залежати від людей.

decisions.choice: take refuge: run to for shelter
decisions.reason: As in 2:12 and 7:2, the verb (chasah) is to seek shelter in someone.

decisions.choice: do not trust in mortals
decisions.reason: 146:3 and Jeremiah 17:5-7 say the same: human help fails, the LORD does not.

decisions.choice: make the LORD your refuge (B); run to the LORD for safety (R)
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms.

decisions.choice: "nương náu nơi CHÚA" (L); "lấy CHÚA làm nơi ẩn náu" (B); "chạy đến với CHÚA để được an toàn" (R), as Psalm 7:2
decisions.reason: The earlier Psalms set these forms for taking refuge in God, with "nơi ẩn náu" the terms note's word for refuge. |

decisions.choice: "피하다" / "피난처로 삼다" for taking refuge (verses 8-9)
decisions.reason: The verb is to run for shelter (meaning decision), and "피난처" is the terms note's word for refuge; trusting in people is "의지하다" and "신뢰하다", so the contrast stays.

decisions.choice: искать убежища
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 57:2, the verb of running to God for shelter is "искать убежища", kept apart from the noun "прибежище", which Balanced uses as the English "your refuge".

decisions.choice: chasah b- "身を避ける" (L), "避け所とする" (B), "逃げ込む" (R); batach "信頼する" at every level
decisions.reason: Psalter refuge words (PSA-1); 118:9 the same

source.text: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Better to take refuge in YHWH than to trust in nobles.

en.L: [It is] better to take refuge in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} than to trust in nobles.
en.B: It is better to make {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your refuge than to rely on princes.
en.R: It is better to run to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for safety than to depend on powerful leaders.

fr.L: [Il est] meilleur de se réfugier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} que de se confier aux nobles.
fr.B: Il vaut mieux faire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son refuge que de compter sur les princes.
fr.R: Il vaut mieux courir vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour être en sécurité que de compter sur les chefs puissants.

sw.L: [Ni] bora kukimbilia kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuliko kuwaamini wakuu.
sw.B: Ni afadhali kumfanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa kimbilio lako kuliko kuwategemea wakuu.
sw.R: Ni bora kukimbilia kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} upate usalama kuliko kuwategemea viongozi wenye nguvu.

es.L: Mejor [es] refugiarse en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que confiar en príncipes.
es.B: Es mejor hacer {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu refugio que apoyarte en los príncipes.
es.R: Es mejor correr {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} para estar a salvo que depender de líderes poderosos.

vi.L: [Thà] nương náu nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} còn tốt hơn là tin cậy các bậc quyền quý.
vi.B: Thà lấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm nơi ẩn náu còn hơn nương cậy các vua chúa.
vi.R: Chạy đến với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để được an toàn thì tốt hơn là trông cậy vào những nhà lãnh đạo quyền thế.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 피하는 것이 귀족들을 신뢰하는 것보다 낫다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 피난처로 삼는 것이 고관들을 의지하는 것보다 낫다.
ko.R: 힘 있는 지도자들을 의지하는 것보다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 달려가 피하는 것이 더 낫다.

pt.L: [É] melhor refugiar-se {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}} do que confiar em nobres.
pt.B: É melhor fazer {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} o seu refúgio do que depender de príncipes.
pt.R: É melhor correr para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} em busca de proteção do que depender de líderes poderosos.

am.L: በመኳንንት ከመታመን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} መጠለል ይሻላል።
am.B: በልዑላን ከመመካት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መጠጊያ ማድረግ ይሻላል።
am.R: በኃያላን መሪዎች ከመደገፍ ለደኅንነት ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መሮጥ ይሻላል።

hi.L: प्रधानों पर भरोसा रखने से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शरण लेना उत्तम [है]।
hi.B: राजकुमारों पर निर्भर रहने से अच्छा है \q कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को अपना शरणस्थान बनाओ।
hi.R: शक्तिशाली अगुवों पर निर्भर रहने से अच्छा है \q कि सुरक्षा के लिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पास दौड़ो।

ru.L: Лучше искать убежища в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕ|Яхве}}, \q чем надеяться на знатных.
ru.B: Лучше сделать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} своим прибежищем, \q чем полагаться на князей.
ru.R: Лучше бежать к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} за защитой, \q чем зависеть от сильных правителей.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に身を避けることは、 \q 高貴な者たちに信頼することよりも良い。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を避け所とすることは、 \q 君主たちに信頼することよりも良い。
ja.R: 力のある指導者たちに信頼するよりも、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のもとに逃げ込むほうが良い。

uk.L: Краще шукати притулку в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДІ|Ягве}}, \q ніж покладатися на вельмож.
uk.B: Краще зробити {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} своїм притулком, \q ніж покладатися на князів.
uk.R: Краще бігти по захист до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q ніж залежати від могутніх правителів.

decisions.choice: nobles: people of power
decisions.reason: As in 113:8; even the powerful are only human (146:3).

decisions.choice: make the LORD your refuge (B); run to the LORD for safety (R)
decisions.reason: As in 118:8.

source.text: כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: All nations surrounded me; in [the] name of YHWH indeed I cut them off.

en.L: All nations surrounded me; in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I surely cut them off.
en.B: All the nations closed in around me; in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I drove them back.
en.R: Enemy nations came at me from every side, but with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s power I fought them off.

fr.L: Toutes les nations m’ont entouré ; au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, oui, je les ai repoussées.
fr.B: Toutes les nations se sont resserrées autour de moi ; au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, je les ai repoussées.
fr.R: Des nations ennemies m’ont attaqué de tous les côtés, mais avec la puissance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} je les ai repoussées.

sw.L: Mataifa yote yalinizunguka; kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakika niliwakatilia mbali.
sw.B: Mataifa yote yalinizingira; kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} niliyarudisha nyuma.
sw.R: Mataifa adui yalinijia kutoka kila upande, lakini kwa nguvu za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} niliyafukuza.

es.L: Todas las naciones me rodearon; en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ciertamente las corté.
es.B: Todas las naciones me cercaron; en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} las rechacé.
es.R: Naciones enemigas me atacaron por todos lados, pero con el poder {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} las hice retroceder.

vi.L: Mọi dân tộc đã vây quanh tôi; nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi chắc chắn đã đánh đuổi chúng.
vi.B: Mọi dân tộc đã bủa vây tôi; nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đã đẩy lui chúng.
vi.R: Các dân tộc thù địch xông vào tôi từ mọi phía, nhưng nhờ quyền năng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tôi đã đánh đuổi chúng.

ko.L: 모든 민족이 나를 에워쌌으나, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 내가 참으로 그들을 끊어 버렸다.
ko.B: 모든 민족이 나를 둘러쌌으나, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 내가 그들을 물리쳤다.
ko.R: 원수 나라들이 사방에서 나에게 몰려왔지만, 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 능력으로 그들을 물리쳤다.

pt.L: Todas as nações me cercaram; em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu certamente as eliminei.
pt.B: Todas as nações se fecharam ao meu redor; em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu as rechacei.
pt.R: Nações inimigas vieram contra mim de todos os lados, mas com o poder {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu as derrotei.

am.L: ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ከበቡኝ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም በእርግጥ እቆርጣቸዋለሁ።
am.B: ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ዙሪያዬን ከበቡኝ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም መለስኳቸው።
am.R: ጠላት ሕዝቦች ከየአቅጣጫው መጡብኝ፤ ነገር ግን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ኃይል መከትኳቸው።

hi.L: सब जातियों ने मुझे घेर लिया; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से मैंने निश्चय उन्हें काट डाला।
hi.B: सब देशों ने मुझे चारों ओर से घेर लिया; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से मैंने उन्हें खदेड़ दिया।
hi.R: शत्रु देश हर तरफ़ से मुझ पर टूट पड़े, \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शक्ति से मैंने उन्हें मार भगाया।

ru.L: Все народы окружили меня; \q во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я истреблю их.
ru.B: Все народы обступили меня; \q во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я отразил их.
ru.R: Вражеские народы нападали на меня со всех сторон, \q но силой {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я отбился от них.

ja.L: 諸国の民がみな、わたしを取り囲んだ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって、まことに、わたしは彼らを断ち切った。
ja.B: 諸国の民がこぞって、わたしを取り囲んだ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって、わたしは彼らを追い払った。
ja.R: 敵の国々が、四方からわたしに攻めて来た。 \q しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の力によって、わたしは彼らを追い返した。

uk.L: Усі народи оточили мене; \q імʼям {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я справді знищив їх.
uk.B: Усі народи обступили мене; \q імʼям {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я відкинув їх.
uk.R: Ворожі народи напали на мене з усіх боків, \q але силою {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я відбився від них.

decisions.choice: all nations surrounded me: the king in battle
decisions.reason: The speaker is surrounded by nations, which suits a king leading Israel in war, or Israel itself speaking as one person.

decisions.choice: in the name of the LORD: by his authority and power
decisions.reason: To fight in the LORD's name is to fight relying on him and his power (20:6, 8; 1 Samuel 17:45).

decisions.choice: I cut them off: I drove them away
decisions.reason: The verb ('amilam, from mul) is rare in this sense; the same root means to cut, and it may mean "cut off" or "ward off". Either way, the enemies are beaten back "in the name of the LORD".

decisions.choice: with the LORD's power
alternatives: in the name of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says what fighting in the LORD's name means (the meaning decision on the phrase).

decisions.choice: one wording for the line repeated in verses 10-12: L "{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም በእርግጥ እቆርጣቸዋለሁ", B "{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም መለስኳቸው", R "ነገር ግን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ኃይል መከትኳቸው"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the line word for word three times; the Amharic does too at each level.

decisions.choice: one wording for the refrain (verses 10, 11, 12)
decisions.reason: "In the name of the LORD I surely cut them off" has the same Hindi each time: DN के नाम से (L, B), DN की शक्ति से (R), as the English Readable says what the name means.

decisions.choice: я истреблю их
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is the imperfect, with an emphatic particle; Literal says "истреблю" for "cut off", Balanced and Readable say the sense, drove them back, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The line repeated in 118:10-12 kept word for word per level: "DNの名によって、まことに、わたしは彼らを断ち切った" (L), "…追い払った" (B), R "DNの力によって…追い返した" as the English R
decisions.reason: m3 (uncertain): I drove them away; m2: in the name = by his authority and power

source.text: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They surrounded me, also they surrounded me; in [the] name of YHWH indeed I cut them off.

en.L: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me; in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I surely cut them off.
en.B: They closed in around me, yes, they closed in on every side; in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I drove them back.
en.R: They were all around me, yes, all around me, but with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s power I fought them off.

fr.L: Elles m’ont entouré, oui, elles m’ont entouré ; au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, oui, je les ai repoussées.
fr.B: Elles se sont resserrées autour de moi, oui, elles m’ont cerné de tous côtés ; au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, je les ai repoussées.
fr.R: Elles étaient tout autour de moi, oui, tout autour de moi, mais avec la puissance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} je les ai repoussées.

sw.L: Walinizunguka, naam, walinizunguka; kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakika niliwakatilia mbali.
sw.B: Walinizingira, naam, walinizingira pande zote; kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} niliwarudisha nyuma.
sw.R: Walinizunguka pande zote, naam, pande zote, lakini kwa nguvu za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} niliwafukuza.

es.L: Me rodearon, sí, me rodearon; en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ciertamente las corté.
es.B: Me cercaron, sí, me cercaron por todos lados; en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} las rechacé.
es.R: Estaban a mi alrededor, sí, a mi alrededor, pero con el poder {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} las hice retroceder.

vi.L: Chúng đã vây quanh tôi, phải, chúng đã vây quanh tôi; nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi chắc chắn đã đánh đuổi chúng.
vi.B: Chúng bủa vây tôi, phải, chúng vây kín tôi mọi phía; nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đã đẩy lui chúng.
vi.R: Chúng vây quanh tôi, phải, vây quanh tôi khắp phía, nhưng nhờ quyền năng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tôi đã đánh đuổi chúng.

ko.L: 그들이 나를 에워쌌다, 참으로 나를 에워쌌다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 내가 참으로 그들을 끊어 버렸다.
ko.B: 그들이 나를 둘러쌌다. 참으로 사방에서 나를 둘러쌌다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 내가 그들을 물리쳤다.
ko.R: 그들이 나를 둘러쌌다. 정말 사방에서 둘러쌌다. 그러나 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 능력으로 그들을 물리쳤다.

pt.L: Cercaram-me, sim, cercaram-me; em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu certamente as eliminei.
pt.B: Fecharam-se ao meu redor, sim, fecharam-se por todos os lados; em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu as rechacei.
pt.R: Estavam todas ao meu redor, sim, todas ao meu redor, mas com o poder {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu as derrotei.

am.L: ከበቡኝ፤ አዎን፣ ከበቡኝ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም በእርግጥ እቆርጣቸዋለሁ።
am.B: ዙሪያዬን ከበቡኝ፤ አዎን፣ ከየአቅጣጫው ከበቡኝ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም መለስኳቸው።
am.R: በዙሪያዬ ሁሉ ነበሩ፤ አዎን፣ በዙሪያዬ ሁሉ፤ ነገር ግን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ኃይል መከትኳቸው።

hi.L: उन्होंने मुझे घेर लिया, हाँ, उन्होंने मुझे घेर लिया; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से मैंने निश्चय उन्हें काट डाला।
hi.B: उन्होंने मुझे घेर लिया, हाँ, हर ओर से मुझे घेर लिया; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से मैंने उन्हें खदेड़ दिया।
hi.R: वे मेरे चारों ओर थे, हाँ, मेरे चारों ओर, \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शक्ति से मैंने उन्हें मार भगाया।

ru.L: Окружили меня, да, окружили меня; \q во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я истреблю их.
ru.B: Обступили меня, да, обступили со всех сторон; \q во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я отразил их.
ru.R: Они были вокруг меня, да, \q со всех сторон, но силой {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я отбился от них.

ja.L: 彼らはわたしを取り囲んだ。まことに、わたしを取り囲んだ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって、まことに、わたしは彼らを断ち切った。
ja.B: 彼らはわたしを取り囲んだ。そうだ、四方からわたしを取り囲んだ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって、わたしは彼らを追い払った。
ja.R: 彼らはわたしの周りにいた。そうだ、周りじゅうにいた。 \q しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の力によって、わたしは彼らを追い返した。

uk.L: Оточили мене, так, оточили мене; \q імʼям {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я справді знищив їх.
uk.B: Обступили мене, так, обступили з усіх боків; \q імʼям {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я відкинув їх.
uk.R: Вони були навколо мене, так, \q усюди навколо мене, але силою {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я відбився від них.

decisions.choice: the repetition: being hemmed in on every side
decisions.reason: The verb is repeated, as is the line about the name of the LORD, to build the feeling of danger and of the victory (verses 10-12).

decisions.choice: in the name of the LORD: by his authority and power
I cut them off: I drove them away
with the LORD's power
alternatives: in the name of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says what fighting in the LORD's name means (the meaning decision on the phrase).

source.text: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They surrounded me like bees; they were extinguished like a fire of thorns; in [the] name of YHWH indeed I cut them off.

en.L: They surrounded me like bees; they were extinguished like a fire of thorns; in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I surely cut them off.
en.B: They came at me like a swarm of bees, but they burned out like a fire in thornbushes; in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I drove them back.
en.R: They attacked me like a swarm of bees. But they were gone as quickly as a fire in dry thorns burns out. With {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s power I fought them off.

fr.L: Elles m’ont entouré comme des abeilles ; elles se sont éteintes comme un feu d’épines ; au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, oui, je les ai repoussées.
fr.B: Elles sont venues sur moi comme un essaim d’abeilles, mais elles se sont éteintes comme un feu de broussailles ; au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, je les ai repoussées.
fr.R: Elles m’ont attaqué comme un essaim d’abeilles. Mais elles ont disparu aussi vite qu’un feu d’épines sèches s’éteint. Avec la puissance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, je les ai repoussées.

sw.L: Walinizunguka kama nyuki; walizimika kama moto wa miiba; kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakika niliwakatilia mbali.
sw.B: Walinijia kama kundi la nyuki, lakini walizimika kama moto wa vichaka vya miiba; kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} niliwarudisha nyuma.
sw.R: Walinishambulia kama kundi la nyuki. Lakini walitoweka haraka kama moto wa miiba mikavu unavyozimika. Kwa nguvu za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} niliwafukuza.

es.L: Me rodearon como abejas; se apagaron como fuego de espinos; en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ciertamente las corté.
es.B: Me atacaron como un enjambre de abejas, pero se apagaron como fuego en los espinos; en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} las rechacé.
es.R: Me atacaron como un enjambre de abejas. Pero desaparecieron tan rápido como se apaga un fuego de espinos secos. Con el poder {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} las hice retroceder.

vi.L: Chúng đã vây quanh tôi như đàn ong; chúng đã bị dập tắt như lửa gai; nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi chắc chắn đã đánh đuổi chúng.
vi.B: Chúng xông vào tôi như đàn ong, nhưng chúng tàn lụi như lửa đốt bụi gai; nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đã đẩy lui chúng.
vi.R: Chúng tấn công tôi như một đàn ong. Nhưng chúng biến mất nhanh như ngọn lửa đốt gai khô vụt tắt. Nhờ quyền năng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tôi đã đánh đuổi chúng.

ko.L: 그들이 벌 떼처럼 나를 에워쌌으나, 가시덤불의 불처럼 꺼졌다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 내가 참으로 그들을 끊어 버렸다.
ko.B: 그들이 벌 떼처럼 나에게 달려들었으나, 가시덤불에 붙은 불처럼 꺼져 버렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 내가 그들을 물리쳤다.
ko.R: 그들은 벌 떼처럼 나를 공격했다. 그러나 마른 가시덤불에 붙은 불이 금방 꺼지듯 사라져 버렸다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 능력으로 그들을 물리쳤다.

pt.L: Cercaram-me como abelhas; foram apagadas como fogo de espinhos; em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu certamente as eliminei.
pt.B: Vieram contra mim como um enxame de abelhas, mas se apagaram como fogo em espinheiros; em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu as rechacei.
pt.R: Elas me atacaram como um enxame de abelhas. Mas desapareceram tão depressa quanto um fogo em espinhos secos se apaga. Com o poder {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eu as derrotei.

am.L: እንደ ንብ ከበቡኝ፤ እንደ እሾህ እሳት ጠፉ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም በእርግጥ እቆርጣቸዋለሁ።
am.B: እንደ ንብ መንጋ መጡብኝ፤ ነገር ግን እንደ እሾህ እሳት ተቃጥለው ጠፉ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም መለስኳቸው።
am.R: እንደ ንብ መንጋ አጠቁኝ። ነገር ግን በደረቅ እሾህ ላይ እንደሚነድ እሳት ቶሎ ጠፉ። {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ኃይል መከትኳቸው።

hi.L: उन्होंने मधुमक्खियों के समान मुझे घेर लिया; वे काँटों की आग के समान बुझ गए; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से मैंने निश्चय उन्हें काट डाला।
hi.B: वे मधुमक्खियों के झुंड के समान मुझ पर टूट पड़े, पर काँटों की आग के समान बुझ गए; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से मैंने उन्हें खदेड़ दिया।
hi.R: उन्होंने मधुमक्खियों के झुंड की तरह मुझ पर हमला किया। पर वे उतनी ही जल्दी ख़त्म हो गए जितनी जल्दी सूखे काँटों की आग बुझ जाती है। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शक्ति से मैंने उन्हें मार भगाया।

ru.L: Окружили меня, как пчёлы; угасли, как огонь в терновнике; \q во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я истреблю их.
ru.B: Они налетели на меня, как рой пчёл, но сгорели, как огонь в терновнике; \q во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я отразил их.
ru.R: Они нападали на меня, как рой пчёл. Но они исчезли так же быстро, как сгорает огонь в сухих колючках. \q Силой {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я отбился от них.

ja.L: 彼らは蜂のようにわたしを取り囲んだ。彼らは茨の火のように消された。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって、まことに、わたしは彼らを断ち切った。
ja.B: 彼らは蜂の群れのようにわたしに襲いかかったが、茨の火のように燃え尽きた。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名によって、わたしは彼らを追い払った。
ja.R: 彼らは蜂の群れのようにわたしを襲った。けれども、乾いた茨の火がすぐに消えるように、いなくなった。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の力によって、わたしは彼らを追い返した。

uk.L: Оточили мене, як бджоли; згасли, як вогонь у терні; \q імʼям {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я справді знищив їх.
uk.B: Вони налетіли на мене, як рій бджіл, але згоріли, як вогонь у терновому кущі; \q імʼям {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я відкинув їх.
uk.R: Вони напали на мене, як рій бджіл. Але зникли так само швидко, як догорає вогонь у сухому терні. \q Силою {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я відбився від них.

decisions.choice: like bees: a swarm that stings from every side
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 1:44 pictures the Amorites chasing Israel "as bees do".

decisions.choice: they were put out: as in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text says the enemies "were extinguished" like a thorn fire, which flares up and quickly dies. The ancient Greek translation has "they blazed up", which goes with the fierceness of the attack. The renderings follow the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: in the name of the LORD: by his authority and power
I cut them off: I drove them away
with the LORD's power
alternatives: in the name of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says what fighting in the LORD's name means (the meaning decision on the phrase).

decisions.choice: do'akhu "消された" (L), "燃え尽きた" (B), "消えるように、いなくなった" (R), following the Hebrew text as m2
decisions.reason: m2 (uncertain, footnote): they were put out, as in the Hebrew text

source.text: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Pushing you pushed me to fall, but YHWH helped me.

en.L: You pushed me hard so that I would fall, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} helped me.
en.B: You shoved me hard to make me fall, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to my help.
en.R: My enemy pushed me hard to knock me down, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} helped me.

fr.L: Tu m’as poussé, poussé, pour que je tombe, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a aidé.
fr.B: Tu m’as bousculé violemment pour me faire tomber, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est venu à mon secours.
fr.R: Mon ennemi m’a poussé très fort pour me faire tomber, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a aidé.

sw.L: Ulinisukuma kwa nguvu ili nianguke, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinisaidia.
sw.B: Ulinisukuma kwa nguvu unitupe chini, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuja kunisaidia.
sw.R: Adui yangu alinisukuma kwa nguvu ili kuniangusha, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinisaidia.

es.L: Me empujaste con fuerza para que cayera, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ayudó.
es.B: Me empujaste con violencia para hacerme caer, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vino en mi ayuda.
es.R: Mi enemigo me empujó con fuerza para derribarme, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ayudó.

vi.L: Ngươi đã xô tôi mạnh để tôi ngã, nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giúp đỡ tôi.
vi.B: Ngươi xô đẩy tôi thật mạnh để làm tôi ngã, nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đến giúp tôi.
vi.R: Kẻ thù xô tôi thật mạnh để quật ngã tôi, nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giúp đỡ tôi.

ko.L: 네가 나를 세게 밀어 넘어뜨리려 하였으나, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 도우셨다.
ko.B: 네가 나를 힘껏 밀쳐 쓰러뜨리려 했지만, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 도우러 오셨다.
ko.R: 내 원수가 나를 세게 밀어 쓰러뜨리려 했지만, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 도와주셨다.

pt.L: Você me empurrou com força para que eu caísse, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me ajudou.
pt.B: Você me empurrou com força para me derrubar, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} veio em meu socorro.
pt.R: O meu inimigo me empurrou com força para me derrubar, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me ajudou.

am.L: እንድወድቅ አጥብቀህ ገፋኸኝ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ረዳኝ።
am.B: እንድወድቅ በኃይል ገፋኸኝ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ደረሰልኝ።
am.R: ጠላቴ ሊጥለኝ በኃይል ገፋኝ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ረዳኝ።

hi.L: तुमने मुझे गिराने के लिए ज़ोर से धक्का दिया, \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मेरी सहायता की।
hi.B: तुमने मुझे गिराने के लिए ज़ोर से धकेला, \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरी सहायता को आए।
hi.R: मेरे शत्रु ने मुझे गिराने के लिए ज़ोर से धक्का दिया, \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मेरी सहायता की।

ru.L: Ты сильно толкнул меня, чтобы я упал, \q но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} помог мне.
ru.B: Ты сильно толкнул меня, чтобы я упал, \q но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} пришёл мне на помощь.
ru.R: Мой враг сильно толкнул меня, чтобы сбить с ног, \q но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} помог мне.

ja.L: おまえはわたしを激しく押した、わたしが倒れるように。 \q しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしを助けてくださった。
ja.B: おまえはわたしを倒そうとして激しく突いたが、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が助けに来てくださった。
ja.R: 敵はわたしを倒そうとして、強く押した。 \q けれども、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が助けてくださった。

uk.L: Ти сильно штовхав мене, щоб я впав, \q але {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} допоміг мені.
uk.B: Ти щосили штовхнув мене, щоб я впав, \q але {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} прийшов мені на допомогу.
uk.R: Мій ворог сильно штовхав мене, щоб звалити, \q але {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} допоміг мені.

decisions.choice: you: the enemy, addressed directly
decisions.reason: The speaker suddenly turns to the enemy, now spoken of as one. The doubled verb stresses the force of the push.

decisions.choice: you pushed me: as in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation and other early versions read "I was pushed". The renderings follow the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: My enemy
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed, to avoid confusion with God (m1).

decisions.choice: "Ngươi" (L, B) for the enemy spoken to; Readable says "Kẻ thù" (the enemy), as the English Readable does
decisions.reason: The singer turns to speak to his enemy (see the meaning decision); "ngươi" is the old word of scorn or distance, as for the liar in Psalm 120:3. |

decisions.choice: The enemy is addressed as "너" in the plain style
decisions.reason: The speaker turns to the enemy for one line (meaning decision), and Korean speaks to him as one speaks to a foe; Readable says "내 원수가", as the English Readable says "my enemy".

decisions.choice: Você
decisions.reason: The speaker turns to the enemy (m1), a human being, so he says "você", as people address each other in this book; "tu" is kept for God.

decisions.choice: तुम to the enemy
decisions.reason: The psalmist turns to the enemy (m1); Hindi keeps तू for God, so the enemy is तुम.

decisions.choice: ты (to the enemy, no span)
decisions.reason: The psalmist turns to the enemy (meaning decision), one person in the Hebrew; Russian says "ты", with no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: The enemy addressed "おまえ" (L, B); R "敵" as the English R
decisions.reason: As 52:3, 55:14: あなた is kept for God; m1, m2 (uncertain): you, the enemy

source.text: עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: My strength and song [is] Yah, and he has become for me salvation.

en.L: My strength and song [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has become my salvation.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} is my strength and the theme of my song; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has come to my rescue.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} makes me strong and gives me a song to sing. He has saved me.

fr.L: Ma force et [mon] chant, [c’est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu pour moi le salut.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} est ma force et le sujet de mon chant ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu me sauver.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} me rend fort et me donne un chant à chanter. Il m’a sauvé.

sw.L: Nguvu yangu na wimbo [wangu] ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amekuwa wokovu kwangu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} ni nguvu yangu na kiini cha wimbo wangu; amekuja kuniokoa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} hunipa nguvu na kunipa wimbo wa kuimba. Ameniokoa.

es.L: Mi fuerza y [mi] canto [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha llegado a ser mi salvación.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} es mi fuerza y el motivo de mi canto; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha venido a rescatarme.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} me hace fuerte y me da un canto para cantar. Él me ha salvado.

vi.L: Sức mạnh và bài ca của tôi [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở nên sự cứu rỗi của tôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} là sức mạnh và là bài ca của tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đến giải cứu tôi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ và cho tôi một bài ca để hát. Ngài đã cứu tôi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야}}는 나의 힘이요 노래이시니, 그분께서 나의 구원이 되셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}께서는 나의 힘이시요 내 노래의 주제이시니, 그분께서 나를 구원하셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 나를 강하게 하시고 내게 부를 노래를 주신다. 그분께서 나를 구원하셨다.

pt.L: A minha força e [o meu] cântico [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou a minha salvação.
pt.B: A minha força e o meu cântico é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} veio para me salvar.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Iá}} me dá forças, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é o motivo do meu canto. Ele me salvou.

am.L: ብርታቴና መዝሙሬ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} [ነው]፤ እርሱም መዳን ሆነልኝ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ብርታቴና ዝማሬዬ ነው፤ ሊያድነኝም መጣ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ብርታት ይሰጠኛል፤ የምዘምረውም ስለ እርሱ ነው። እርሱ አድኖኛል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} मेरा बल और गीत [हैं], \q और वे मेरे लिए उद्धार बन गए हैं।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} मेरा बल और मेरा गीत हैं; \q वे मेरा उद्धार करने आए हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} मुझे बल देते हैं और गाने के लिए गीत देते हैं। \q उन्होंने मुझे बचाया है।

ru.L: Сила моя и песнь — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}}, \q и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стал мне спасением.
ru.B: Моя сила и моя песнь — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} пришёл спасти меня.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}} даёт мне силу и песню, \q которую я пою. Он спас меня.

ja.L: わたしの力、わたしの歌は{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}。 \q その方はわたしの救いとなられた。
ja.B: わたしの力、わたしの歌は{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}。 \q その方は、わたしを救うために来てくださった。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}はわたしを強くしてくださる。わたしが歌うのは、その方のためだ。 \q その方はわたしを救ってくださった。

uk.L: Моя сила й пісня — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}}, \q і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} став моїм спасінням.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}} — моя сила і тема моєї пісні; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} прийшов мене врятувати.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}} робить мене сильним і дає мені пісню, щоб співати. \q Він урятував мене.

decisions.choice: the Song of the Sea: Exodus 15:2
decisions.reason: The line is word for word from the song Moses and Israel sang after crossing the sea (Exodus 15:2), also taken up in Isaiah 12:2. The rescue is celebrated as a new exodus.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in 68:5 and Exodus 15:2). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: song: a song of praise, or might
decisions.reason: The word (zimrat) usually means song; some take it here, as in Exodus 15:2, as "strength" or "protection", a second word for the same thing.

decisions.choice: come to my rescue (B); saved me (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what it means that he has become salvation for me.

decisions.choice: "sự cứu rỗi" (L); "giải cứu" (B); "cứu" (R), as the terms note and the English levels
decisions.reason: The line repeats the Song of the Sea (see the meaning decision). Literal keeps the noun; Balanced and Readable say it with a verb, as the English does. |

decisions.choice: the words of Exodus 15:2
alternatives: a wording of the psalm's own
decisions.reason: The line is taken word for word from the Song of the Sea (m1), so each level repeats the first half of Exodus 15:2 in its Portuguese, with "Iá" as the alternative for the short name.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of Exodus 15:2 at each level
decisions.reason: The verse is word for word the opening of the Song of the Sea (Exodus 15:2), so the Amharic on main is kept.

decisions.choice: wording of Exodus 15:2
decisions.reason: The line is from the Song of the Sea (m1), and Literal and Balanced keep the wording of Exodus 15:2; Readable follows this verse's own English.

decisions.choice: the wording of Exodus 15:2
decisions.reason: The line repeats the Song of the Sea word for word, so Literal and Balanced keep the Russian of Exodus 15:2; Readable keeps its sense in shorter words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Worded as Exodus 15:2 in the Japanese Exodus draft (わたしの力、わたしの歌は主[ヤハ]), with その方 for Exodus' この方
decisions.reason: m1: the Song of the Sea; the echo is kept recognizable

source.text: ק֤וֹל׀רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sound of [a] glad shout and salvation [is] in [the] tents of [the] righteous: [The] right hand of YHWH does valiantly.

en.L: The sound of a glad shout and of salvation [is] in the tents of the righteous: "The right hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does valiantly!
en.B: The tents of the righteous ring with glad shouts of rescue: "The right hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} acts with power!
en.R: People who do what is right are shouting for joy in their tents because they have been saved: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has used {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power!

fr.L: Un bruit de cris de joie et de salut [est] dans les tentes des justes : « La droite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} agit avec vaillance !
fr.B: Les tentes des justes retentissent de cris de joie pour leur délivrance : « La main droite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} agit avec puissance !
fr.R: Les gens qui font ce qui est juste crient de joie dans leurs tentes, parce qu’ils ont été sauvés : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a montré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance !

sw.L: Sauti ya shangwe na ya wokovu [iko] katika hema za wenye haki: "Mkono wa kuume wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unatenda kwa ushujaa!
sw.B: Hema za wenye haki zinavuma kwa kelele za furaha ya wokovu: "Mkono wa kuume wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unatenda kwa nguvu!
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda yaliyo haki wanapiga kelele za furaha katika hema zao kwa sababu wameokolewa: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu!

es.L: Voz de júbilo y de salvación [hay] en las tiendas de los justos: «¡La diestra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hace proezas!
es.B: Las tiendas de los justos resuenan con gritos alegres de rescate: «¡La mano derecha {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} actúa con poder!
es.R: Los que hacen lo correcto gritan de alegría en sus tiendas porque han sido salvados: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha usado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder!

vi.L: Tiếng reo vui và [tiếng] cứu rỗi [ở] trong các lều trại của những người công chính: "Tay phải của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm việc dũng mãnh!
vi.B: Các lều trại của người công chính vang tiếng reo mừng được giải cứu: "Tay phải của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra tay quyền năng!
vi.R: Những người làm điều đúng đang reo hò vui mừng trong lều của họ vì họ đã được cứu: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dùng quyền năng lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 기쁜 외침과 구원의 소리가 의인들의 장막에 [있다]. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 오른손이 용맹을 떨치신다!
ko.B: 의인들의 장막마다 구원을 기뻐하는 외침이 울려 퍼진다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 오른손이 능력을 베푸신다!
ko.R: 바르게 사는 사람들이 구원을 받고서 자기 장막에서 기뻐 외친다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 큰 능력을 베푸셨다!

pt.L: Som de grito de alegria e de salvação [há] nas tendas dos justos: "A mão direita {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} age com valentia!
pt.B: As tendas dos justos ressoam com gritos alegres de livramento: "A mão direita {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} age com poder!
pt.R: As pessoas que fazem o que é certo gritam de alegria nas suas tendas, porque foram salvas: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} usou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande poder!

am.L: የእልልታና የመዳን ድምፅ በጻድቃን ድንኳኖች ውስጥ [አለ]፦ «{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀኝ እጅ ጀግንነትን ታደርጋለች!
am.B: የጻድቃን ድንኳኖች በመዳን እልልታ ይደምቃሉ፦ «{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀኝ እጅ በኃይል ትሠራለች!
am.R: ትክክል የሆነውን የሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ስለ ዳኑ በድንኳኖቻቸው ውስጥ በደስታ እልል ይላሉ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቁን ኃይሉን ተጠቀመ!

hi.L: धर्मियों के तंबुओं में जयजयकार और उद्धार का शब्द [है]: \q "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दाहिना हाथ पराक्रम करता है!
hi.B: धर्मियों के तंबू छुटकारे के आनंद-भरे नारों से गूँज उठते हैं: \q "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दाहिना हाथ सामर्थ्य से काम करता है!
hi.R: जो लोग सही काम करते हैं, वे अपने तंबुओं में आनंद से जयजयकार कर रहे हैं, \q क्योंकि वे बचाए गए हैं: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी महान शक्ति दिखाई है!

ru.L: Голос ликования и спасения — в шатрах праведных: \q «Десница {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} творит силу!
ru.B: Шатры праведных звенят радостными криками спасения: \q «Правая рука {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} действует с силой!
ru.R: Люди, которые поступают правильно, радостно кричат в своих шатрах, \q потому что они спасены: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} показал свою великую силу!

ja.L: 喜びの叫びと救いの声が、正しい者たちの天幕にある。 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の右の手は力ある業をなす！
ja.B: 正しい人たちの天幕に、救いを喜ぶ歓声が響く。 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の右の手は力強く働く！
ja.R: 正しいことをする人たちが、救われたことを喜んで、自分たちのテントで叫んでいる。 \q 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は大きな力をふるってくださった！

uk.L: Голос радісного вигуку й спасіння — в наметах праведних: \q «Правиця {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} чинить звитяжно!
uk.B: Намети праведних лунають радісними вигуками порятунку: \q «Правиця {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} діє з силою!
uk.R: Люди, які чинять правильно, радісно вигукують у своїх наметах, \q бо їх урятовано: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} показав свою велику силу!

decisions.choice: the shout quoted through verse 16
decisions.reason: The words after the colon are the shout heard in the tents; the quotation runs to the end of verse 16.

decisions.choice: the right hand of the LORD: his power in action
decisions.reason: The right hand is the hand of strength; the words echo Exodus 15:6, 12.

decisions.choice: does valiantly: acts with might
decisions.reason: The phrase ('oseh chayil) is to show strength, as a warrior does (60:14).

decisions.choice: the LORD has used his great power
alternatives: the right hand of the LORD does valiantly
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: "does valiantly" as "ጀግንነትን ታደርጋለች" (L), as 60:14 and 108:14
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: десница (L); правая рука (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the solemn "десница" for the right hand of God; Balanced says "правая рука", as Psalm 60:7 in this translation, and Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: свою (no span)
decisions.reason: The English Readable has a span on "his great power"; Russian uses the reflexive "свою", which takes no span (also verse 16).

decisions.choice: The shout opens with 「 here and closes with 」 at the end of 118:16, as the English quotation
decisions.reason: m1: the shout is quoted through verse 16

source.text: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] right hand of YHWH [is] lifted high; [the] right hand of YHWH does valiantly.

en.L: The right hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] lifted high; the right hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does valiantly!"
en.B: The right hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is raised in triumph; the right hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} acts with power!"
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has raised {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand to win the victory. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has used {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power!"

fr.L: La droite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] élevée ; la droite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} agit avec vaillance ! »
fr.B: La main droite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} se lève en triomphe ; la main droite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} agit avec puissance ! »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a levé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main pour remporter la victoire. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a montré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance ! »

sw.L: Mkono wa kuume wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} umeinuka juu; mkono wa kuume wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unatenda kwa ushujaa!"
sw.B: Mkono wa kuume wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} umeinuliwa kwa ushindi; mkono wa kuume wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unatenda kwa nguvu!"
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameinua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kupata ushindi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu!"

es.L: ¡La diestra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] levantada en alto; la diestra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hace proezas!».
es.B: ¡La mano derecha {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se alza en triunfo; la mano derecha {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} actúa con poder!».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha levantado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano para ganar la victoria. ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha usado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder!».

vi.L: Tay phải của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [được] giơ cao; tay phải của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm việc dũng mãnh!"
vi.B: Tay phải của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giơ lên đắc thắng; tay phải của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra tay quyền năng!"
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên để giành chiến thắng. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dùng quyền năng lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 오른손이 높이 들렸고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 오른손이 용맹을 떨치신다!"
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 오른손이 승리로 높이 들리고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 오른손이 능력을 베푸신다!"
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 손을 높이 드시고 승리를 거두셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 큰 능력을 베푸셨다!"

pt.L: A mão direita {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [está] exaltada; a mão direita {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} age com valentia!"
pt.B: A mão direita {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se ergue em triunfo; a mão direita {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} age com poder!"
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} levantou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão para vencer. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} usou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande poder!"

am.L: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀኝ እጅ ከፍ ከፍ ብላለች፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀኝ እጅ ጀግንነትን ታደርጋለች!»
am.B: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀኝ እጅ በድል ከፍ ብላለች፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀኝ እጅ በኃይል ትሠራለች!»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ድል ለማድረግ እጁን አነሣ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቁን ኃይሉን ተጠቀመ!»

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दाहिना हाथ ऊँचा उठा [है]; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दाहिना हाथ पराक्रम करता है!"
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दाहिना हाथ विजय में ऊँचा उठा है; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दाहिना हाथ सामर्थ्य से काम करता है!"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने जीत पाने के लिए अपना हाथ उठाया है। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी महान शक्ति दिखाई है!"

ru.L: Десница {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} высоко поднята; \q десница {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} творит силу!»
ru.B: Правая рука {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} поднята в победе; \q правая рука {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} действует с силой!»
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поднял свою руку, чтобы победить. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} показал свою великую силу!»

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の右の手は高く上げられ、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の右の手は力ある業をなす！」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の右の手は勝利のうちに高く上げられ、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の右の手は力強く働く！」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は手を高く上げて、勝利を収めてくださった。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は大きな力をふるってくださった！」

uk.L: Правиця {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} піднесена; \q правиця {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} чинить звитяжно!»
uk.B: Правиця {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} піднята в тріумфі; \q правиця {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} діє з силою!»
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} підняв свою руку й здобув перемогу. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} показав свою велику силу!»

decisions.choice: lifted high: raised in victory
decisions.reason: The form (romemah) may mean that the LORD's hand is raised high in victory, or that it lifts up the one it saves.

decisions.choice: the right hand of the LORD
has raised his hand to win the victory
alternatives: the right hand of the LORD is lifted high
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m1).

source.text: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי־אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not I will die, but I will live, and I will recount [the] deeds of Yah.

en.L: I will not die, but I will live, and I will recount the deeds of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}.
en.B: I am not going to die; I will live and tell what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} has done.
en.R: I will not die! I will live and tell everyone what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} has done.

fr.L: Je ne mourrai pas, mais je vivrai, et je raconterai les œuvres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yah}}.
fr.B: Non, je ne vais pas mourir ; je vivrai et je raconterai ce qu’a fait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}.
fr.R: Je ne mourrai pas ! Je vivrai et je raconterai à tout le monde ce qu’a fait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}.

sw.L: Sitakufa, ila nitaishi, na kuyatangaza matendo ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}.
sw.B: Siendi kufa; nitaishi na kueleza yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} amefanya.
sw.R: Sitakufa! Nitaishi na kumwambia kila mtu yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} amefanya.

es.L: No moriré, sino que viviré, y contaré las obras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yah}}.
es.B: No voy a morir; viviré y contaré lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}} ha hecho.
es.R: ¡No moriré! Viviré y contaré a todos lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}} ha hecho.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ không chết, nhưng tôi sẽ sống, và tôi sẽ thuật lại những công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ không chết đâu; tôi sẽ sống và kể lại những việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã làm.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ không chết! Tôi sẽ sống và kể cho mọi người biết những việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã làm.

ko.L: 나는 죽지 않고 살 것이요, {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 하신 일들을 이야기할 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 죽지 않을 것이다. 살아서 {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 하신 일을 전할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 죽지 않을 것이다! 살아서 {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 하신 일을 모든 사람에게 알릴 것이다.

pt.L: Não morrerei, mas viverei, e contarei os feitos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Iá}}.
pt.B: Eu não vou morrer; vou viver e contar o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}} fez.
pt.R: Eu não vou morrer! Vou viver e contar a todos o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}} fez.

am.L: አልሞትም፤ በሕይወት እኖራለሁ እንጂ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህን}} ሥራዎችም እናገራለሁ።
am.B: አልሞትም፤ በሕይወት እኖራለሁ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ያደረገውንም እናገራለሁ።
am.R: አልሞትም! በሕይወት እኖራለሁ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} ያደረገውንም ለሰው ሁሉ እናገራለሁ።

hi.L: मैं न मरूँगा, पर जीवित रहूँगा, \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} के कामों का वर्णन करूँगा।
hi.B: मैं मरनेवाला नहीं हूँ; \q मैं जीवित रहूँगा और बताऊँगा कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने क्या किया है।
hi.R: मैं नहीं मरूँगा! मैं जीवित रहूँगा और सब को बताऊँगा \q कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने क्या किया है।

ru.L: Не умру, но буду жить \q и возвещать дела {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}.
ru.B: Я не умру; я буду жить и рассказывать о том, \q что сделал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}}.
ru.R: Я не умру! Я буду жить и всем рассказывать, \q что сделал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}}.

ja.L: わたしは死なず、生きる。 \q そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}のみわざを語り告げる。
ja.B: わたしは死なない。 \q 生きて、{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}がなさったことを語り伝えよう。
ja.R: わたしは死なない！ \q 生きて、{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}がしてくださったことを、みんなに話そう。

uk.L: Я не помру, але житиму \q і розповідатиму про діла {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}.
uk.B: Я не помру; я житиму й розповідатиму, \q що зробив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}}.
uk.R: Я не помру! Я житиму й розповім усім, \q що зробив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яг}}.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in 68:5 and Exodus 15:2). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: recount: tell in order, declare
decisions.reason: The verb (siper) is to tell over, to rehearse a story (9:2; 78:4).

source.text: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Disciplining Yah has disciplined me, but to the death not he has given me.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} has severely disciplined me, but to death {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has not given me over.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} disciplined me hard, yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not let death take me.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} corrected me very strictly, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not let me die.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} m’a sévèrement corrigé, mais à la mort {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne m’a pas livré.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} m’a durement corrigé, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas laissé la mort me prendre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} m’a corrigé très sévèrement, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne m’a pas laissé mourir.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} ameniadhibu kwa ukali, lakini hakunikabidhi kwa mauti.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} alinirudi kwa nguvu, lakini hakuiacha mauti inichukue.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} alinirekebisha kwa ukali sana, lakini hakuniacha nife.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} me ha disciplinado con severidad, pero a la muerte {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no me ha entregado.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} me disciplinó con dureza, pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no dejó que la muerte me llevara.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} me corrigió con mucha severidad, pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no dejó que muriera.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã sửa phạt tôi nặng nề, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không phó tôi cho sự chết.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã sửa phạt tôi nghiêm khắc, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để sự chết bắt lấy tôi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} đã sửa dạy tôi rất nghiêm khắc, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để tôi chết.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 나를 엄히 징계하셨으나, 죽음에는 나를 넘기지 않으셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 나를 호되게 징계하셨지만, 죽음이 나를 데려가게 하지는 않으셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}께서 나를 아주 엄하게 바로잡으셨지만, 나를 죽게 하지는 않으셨다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Iá}} me disciplinou severamente, mas à morte não me entregou.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Iá}} me disciplinou com dureza, mas não deixou que a morte me levasse.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Iá}} me corrigiu com muito rigor, mas não me deixou morrer.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} አጥብቆ ገሠጸኝ፤ ለሞት ግን አሳልፎ አልሰጠኝም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} እጅግ ቀጣኝ፤ ሞት እንዲወስደኝ ግን አልተወኝም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህ}} በጣም አጥብቆ አረመኝ፤ እንድሞት ግን አልፈቀደም።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने मुझे कड़ी ताड़ना दी है, \q पर मृत्यु के हाथ उन्होंने मुझे नहीं सौंपा।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने मुझे कठोरता से अनुशासित किया, \q फिर भी उन्होंने मृत्यु को मुझे ले जाने न दिया।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} ने मुझे बहुत कड़ाई से सुधारा, \q पर उन्होंने मुझे मरने न दिया।

ru.L: Строго наказал меня {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}}, \q но смерти {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} меня не предал.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ях}} сурово наказал меня, \q но {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не отдал меня смерти.
